What do you know about the Ashtown Bandit?
Here, I wanted to give you this.
Now, tell me about the Ashtown Bandit...
I'll see if I can catch him.

suite.message: What do you want?
I ain't talkin' to no Kariba.
Get outta here!
Woah, a flower?
I... I don't know what to say.
No one's ever gotten me a flower before. I'll make sure to take good care of it.
Well, if you must know...
He stole my screwdriver. It's no big deal, really. I can buy a new one.
But I decided I'd try to catch him in the act, so I left my toolbox out in the open, up at the top level of the Yellow District.
Problem is, I always fall asleep before he shows up, so I'm not really sure if it's going to work.
Best of luck to you. The people around here would owe you a great debt if you caught him.
I already told ya, I ain't talkin' to no Kariba!
Beat it!

responses.message: I need more info about the Bandit.
What do you have against the Kariba?

suite.message: You'll probably only find him at night.
Just waiting around might be boring. If you need to pass the day quickly, just head over to the inn and ask Nana Bane to tell you a story. Always puts me right out.
Remember, I left my toolbox out in the open at the top level of the Yellow District. He won't be able to resist it!
Everything.
All they do is yap about the mother worm and attack us humans for invading their island.
Wasn't my choice to live on this dump!
Anyway, you got me a flower so you're on my good side. But don't push your luck!

messages: I'm pretty tired right now. If you wanna talk, meet me by the mines in the Yellow District.
